quests.title: One corner, on its own
quests.ask: Write `go_around_corner()`: from one cell past a corner, walk to the next corner, pick its gem, then turn onto the next side and take one step along it.
quests.nudge: Where it ends is where the next call starts. Picture both calls before you write it.

quests.title: Two corners in a row
quests.ask: Use it twice on the real block: the first call clears a corner, and the second starts where the first stopped and clears the one below.
quests.nudge: If the second corner goes wrong, look at where the first call leaves the robot.

quests.title: All the way home
quests.ask: Go round the whole block and finish where you started, facing east.
quests.nudge: After the last corner, where is the robot and which way does it face? Is that home?
